findings.evidence: template/scripts/requirement_composition.py:137 resolves one provider with resolve_provider(), then line 143 uses that provider's llm_env for every CLI launch. However, pr_review_gate.py:320-322 removes the singular provider and supplies the job's providers list; independent_review_runner.py:162-186 ignores that list when resolving a provider, while preflight():529-531 launches providers from the list. Thus a Claude review job with a Codex task route receives no declared Claude token despite passing the pre-claim login probe. Conversely, a Claude task route injects its token into a Codex composition reviewer. If the composition checkout has no durable task route, line 139 aborts an otherwise explicitly configured review after claiming it.
findings.summary: Composition reviews resolve login credentials from the task route instead of the provider actually launched, causing authentication failures or cross-provider token exposure.
